setting: You are all in Istanbul, Turkey, working together on a school fundraiser: a winter bazaar with food and craft stalls, planned in a group chat. You know each other through the school's parent and volunteer network. Right now you are finalising the stall rota, collecting donation receipts, and deciding who will cover the café counter on the weekend.
openers: Send a reminder about Saturday's stall rota
Ask who can cover the café counter
Share the updated donation receipt sheet
Confirm the bake sale float with Onur

text: Reminder: Saturday stall rota. Check your slot before you leave for work. Food stall 10–13, craft 13–17. Names are in the shared sheet.
Which sheet
The one Aylin shared on Monday
Got it. I'm down for food 10–13 right?
Yes, with Volkan
Craft 13–17 I have. Nobody has the glaze table yet
I can't do Saturday morning, I'm opening the café. Can do Saturday evening if needed
[photo: donation receipts 1–14]
Bakery and hardware shop ones. The other envelope is still with me
Received, will enter them tonight
Who is on the café counter Sunday
Nobody yet. İrem said she could do Sunday if her mum drives
İrem, is that right
Yes if my mum can. She has the car till 6
Sorry I was in class
I'll take Sunday 14–17 if İrem does the morning. I'm at the café Saturday
Ok so Sunday: İrem 10–14, Volkan 14–17?
Fine. Put it in the sheet
Sheet updated. Glaze table Saturday is me 13–15, then who?
Till Saturday is mine all day. Still need someone for 15–17 on the glaze table
I'll take 15–17, I'm free after 13 anyway. Sorry was on a job till late
[screenshot: stall rota v4]
Looks right to me
I'll send the bank statement to Pınar tomorrow
Thanks. Receipts 15 onwards on Friday
[photo: receipts 15–17]
Only three in this envelope. The rest I'll bring Saturday
Got 15–17. Entering them on the way to a job
Glaze jars, do we have the big ones or only the small ones from last year
Don't know. Check the cupboard by the gym
Caretaker says he has the key till Monday
Saturday evening, I can do 17–19 if the craft table needs cover. Not sure yet
Craft is 13–17, nothing after. Leave it
Mum says she'll drive Sunday. Car is ours till 6 on Sunday too
Statement sent. Tell me if the totals don't match, the bakery transfer might have come in twice
Checking now
Totals match. Bakery transfer was once, the second line is the hardware shop refund
Ah yes. Ok
Can someone bring tape for the sign-up sheet. Mine is finished
I have a roll at the café. Will bring it Sat
Sorry this is late. Just finished a fuse box in Kadıköy, it's a mess
Who has the card reader for Saturday? Last year it was Pınar's
Yes mine. Charged. Will bring
Sunday's on the sheet now, I see it
Good
Setting up at 9. Who has the float
Tin is in my car. I'll bring it
Not counted yet
Café is busy already. Tape is in my bag, I'm here till 12 then I have to go back
Glaze jars: only small ones. Found 9 in the cupboard. Caretaker unlocked it himself after all
We'll tell parents it's small pots only
Small is fine. Put the price on the card
Food stall open. Börek gone already
Who's on with me. Pınar??
Coming, 5 min. Bringing the reader
Is anyone at the craft table yet. I'm here, got a tea
Card reader is dead. Says low battery even though it was charged
Is it plugged in. Sorry, the cable is the grey one, not the white one
Grey one works. Good
Sold 40 lahmacun, not bad
[photo: café queue out the door]
Not coming. Sorry
Glaze table set up. Can someone bring the other tablecloth
I'll get it from the car, mum has the keys
Taking 15–17 on glaze. Going home to eat first
Receipts 1–14 in the blue folder. The rest I can't find, checking the car
Found it. It was under the card reader
Kids doing the glazing already, we have 6 pots going
One child cried because her pot cracked. We'll glue it
Back at glaze table. Quiet
Are we doing 17–19 or not. Café closes at 18, I can come after
Craft is done at 17. Leave it
Till total is 2,140 lira cash, 1,340 card. Counting the rest
Ok. Last year we had about 3,000 by close. We're close
Bring the tin to mine tonight? I'll count it with Pınar tomorrow
Home. Hands are still green from the glaze
Good day
Sunday still 10–14?
Yes. Bring the spare bags from the back of the store room, the box is marked
Tin counted. 3,480 total with the card. Writing it down
Pınar check it before I put it in the sheet
Checked. Matches. Bank tomorrow
Café shut. Brought the tape after all, nobody needed it
Mum rang, the boiler at the flat is out. Going to be late for the bank run, I'll message in the morning
